rapport_notes: Friendly and patient, but somewhat formulaic; no personal warmth or memorable moments.
process_discipline_notes: After the estimate range ('four to five or six hours'), Calvin did not hold silence — he immediately continued with explanation rather than allowing the customer space to absorb or respond.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly to logistics ('how many bedrooms') without establishing customer's priorities or concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no customer agenda was surfaced, so no concerns to probe deeper on.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered in Stage 3 as part of pricing explanation: 'included in our hourly rate is our no worries damage coverage...up to $2,000 per move.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Covered in Stage 3 handoff: 'You will get to meet your movers email, I think in the next day or two. It'll just let you know who the guys are going to be. They're all on our website with their pictures and BIOS.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Covered in Stage 3: 'we also do have an on time guarantee. So, if we're late to any window of arrival we give you we do discount you money back.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Covered in Stage 3: 'we'll check-in again Wednesday with a courtesy text. And then the movers on Thursday morning will actually give you a call directly.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: 'for something like this about a two bedroom ish...I would think you're probably going to be in the range of about four to five or six hours'...personalized by customer's lighter furniture load.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit: 'The hourly rate is all inclusive. So we don't have any trip fees, there's no taxes there's no credit card fees.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: 'The main thing that does add the most time for us is things that don't get boxed, loose miscellaneous items...You kinda mentioned you're handling a lot of that so that will definitely help keep it more efficient for us.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it: 'once we exceed the minimum we bill in fifteen minute increments until the move is completed, so you only pay for the time that is used that day.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep: 'You kinda mentioned you're handling a lot of that so that will definitely help keep it more efficient for us.' (implicit credit for acknowledging prep reduces time/cost.)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_fair_silence: Not present. Calvin asked 'Does that all make sense?' and customer said 'Yup,' but no follow-up silence held; Calvin immediately pivoted to estimate discussion.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: 'if you needed to reschedule or anything came up, there's no fee' (implicit rate-locking language, though not explicitly 'your rate locks when you book').
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: No. Call ended with 'Well, thank you. You have a great rest of your day.' — a polite farewell, not an explicit ask to book or confirm agreement.

top_strength: Calvin delivered a clear, accurate two-man crew estimate with a transparent range ($832–$1,248 over 4–6 hours) anchored to the customer's specific furniture list and floor plan, and then explained all four differentiators (damage coverage, trained crew, on-time guarantee, communication touchpoints) cleanly in Stage 3.
coaching_note: Always ask the customer's agenda first ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?') before diving into logistics — and after giving an estimate range, hold silence and let the customer absorb or ask, rather than immediately launching into the next explanation.
